description: This file contains unit tests for the WordListDictionaryListener class in the com.anysoftkeyboard.ime package, testing its behavior with dictionary loading, handling of word lists, and exception scenarios.

classes.name: WordListDictionaryListenerTest
classes.description: Test class for WordListDictionaryListener, verifying its behavior with dictionary loading and word list processing.

methods.name: testWaitsTillAllDictionariesLoadedBeforeGetWords
methods.description: Tests that the listener waits for all dictionaries to load before invoking the callback with the loaded words.

methods.name: testFailsWhenWordsAndFrequenciesDoNotHaveTheSameLength
methods.description: Verifies that the listener correctly handles the case where the number of words and their frequencies do not match, resulting in no words being reported.

methods.name: testReportsZeroWordsOnException
methods.description: Ensures that if an exception occurs during getLoadedWords, the callback reports zero words.
